body.purpose: Default UI text throughout the app shell.

label.purpose: Station tags, section headers, status pills — the printed-chart register.

mono.purpose: Terminal content, code, search, relay-feed rows.

shadows.name: brand
shadows.purpose: Teal glow — active/selected or primary action only.

shadows.name: glow
shadows.purpose: Faint ambient ink glow behind brand-adjacent chrome.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default hover/focus/active transitions on interactive elements.

components.name: Station Readout
components.description: Sparing-use status circle, retained from the shared vocabulary but secondary to a chip's own fill — a small circle that glows only when lit.
components.css: .ds-lamp { display:inline-block; width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--lamp-color,#6b7276); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.35), 0 0 0 1px rgba(86,93,97,.25); transition: background .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease; } .ds-lamp[data-lit='true'] { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.25), 0 0 6px 1px var(--lamp-color), 0 0 0 1px rgba(86,93,97,.35); }

components.name: Station Tag
components.description: Ink-bordered printed-chart label chip marking a UI element's identity.
components.css: .ds-station-tag { font-family:'Fira Code','JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:9px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#565d61; background:#282e33; border:1px solid rgba(86,93,97,.4); border-radius:3px; padding:1px 5px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Teal-colored primary action button — never red; red is reserved for error/danger.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#2f8f7a; color:#e9e6da; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; padding:8px 20px; border:none; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; transition:filter .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2f8f7a; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.35; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Workspace Identity Chip
components.description: Sidebar workspace/session identity mark — a small rounded-square chip (uploaded icon or plain colored letter), never a circular avatar or dot.
components.css: .ds-id-chip { width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:3px; border:1.5px solid rgba(86,93,97,.35); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; background:rgba(47,143,122,.13); font-family:'Fira Code','JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-weight:700; font-size:12px; color:#2f8f7a; }

components.name: Chart Row (relay feed)
components.description: Agent-summary / system relay row — mono font, single solid ink-tinted top rule, no dashed perforated-tape borders and no colored border-left.
components.css: .ds-relay-row { display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:7px; padding:4px 9px; background:#282e33; border-radius:3px; font-family:'Fira Code','JetBrains Mono',monospace; border-top:1px solid rgba(86,93,97,.3); } .ds-relay-title { font-size:10px; font-weight:600; color:#6b7276; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em; } .ds-relay-text { font-size:11px; color:#a3aaad; }

components.name: Merged Tab Row Header
components.description: Workspace identity, active space pill, and the 'Workspaces' back button render inside the terminal's own tab row, right-aligned — one row of chrome, not a separate header stacked above the tabs.
components.css: .ds-tabrow { display:flex; align-items:flex-end; background:#21262a; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(86,93,97,.2); } .ds-tabrow-right { flex:1; display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; align-items:center; gap:8px; align-self:center; padding-right:4px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.css: .ds-input { background:rgba(233,230,218,.05); border:1px solid rgba(86,93,97,.32); border-radius:4px; padding:8px 12px; color:#e9e6da; font-size:12px; } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; border-color:rgba(47,143,122,.55); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#6b7276; }

narrative.overview:
Orchaterm is styled as a meteorological chart room: printed chart paper, graphite-ink structure, and a single chart-ink teal accent for primary/active state — a calm instrument palette, not an alarm palette. This replaces this project's prior visual worlds ("Flight Strip Board," an air-traffic-control theme, and before that "Central Exchange," a telegraph/switchboard theme) — aluminum, brass, radar-sweep green, straight routing vectors, and patch cords are all retired, along with the original ClickUp-purple SaaS look. An intermediate pass of this same world used red as the primary accent; that read as constant alarm on every button and active state, so red was moved to be exclusively the error color and teal took over primary/active.

This is an Operate-mode surface: a working tool a solo developer runs for hours at a time, not a marketing surface. The world's materials (chart paper, graphite ink) express identity through color, radius, and a handful of named components (the station tag, the chart row, the isobar line) — never through decoration that would slow a developer down mid-task. Window chrome is a single row: workspace identity and tabs share one strip, never a separate header row stacked above the tabs.
keyCharacteristics: One primary accent — chart-ink teal — carries all primary/active meaning; red is reserved exclusively for error/danger.
Tight, mechanical corner radii (3–9px) for panels/controls; small status chips are sharp (0–2px), not round.

No colored border-left accent bars, no dashed perforated-tape row dividers, no straight or curved cable connectors with terminal-jack circles — dependency edges are smooth isobar-style contour curves.
No metal-hardware material (no brass, no aluminum) — deliberately distinct from both retired worlds.
Single-row window chrome — workspace identity and the back button live inside the tab row, not a separate header row.
Two themes (dark = night chart room, light = day chart table), both drawn from the same chart-paper/ink/teal material set.
Curated xterm theme presets are product functionality, left untouched — out of scope for this system.

rules.name: The Teal-Is-Primary Rule
rules.body: Exactly one saturated accent carries primary/active meaning: chart-ink teal. Red is reserved exclusively for error/danger.

rules.name: The Ink-Is-Structure Rule
rules.body: Graphite ink never carries meaning; it only renders structure — borders, dividers, tag chips.

rules.name: The Isobar-Not-Cable Rule
rules.body: Dependency edges render as smooth isobar-style contour curves, never straight vectors and never a cable ending in a jack-terminal circle. Row dividers are a single solid rule, never dashed.

rules.name: The Station-Tag Rule
rules.body: Any label meant to read as a physical marking is set uppercase, tracked (+0.04em or more), and small (10-11px).

rules.name: The Teal-Glow-Only Rule
rules.body: The colored glow shadow is reserved for the primary action or a genuinely active/selected element.

rules.name: The Single-Row Chrome Rule
rules.body: Workspace identity, the active space pill, and the back button render inside the tab row, right-aligned — one row of window chrome, never two.

dos: Do keep teal to primary actions and active/selected state; keep red to error/danger only.
Do keep radii at the tightened hardware scale for panels — do not reintroduce 10-20px soft card rounding.
Do draw workspace/session identity as a small rounded-square chip, never a circular avatar.
Do tint borders, dividers, and scrollbars from graphite ink rather than plain white/black alpha, and never reach for a metal-hardware material.
Do keep window chrome to a single row.
Do leave the xterm theme presets and their exact hex values untouched.
donts: Don't use red for a primary button, active nav/tab state, focus ring, or cursor — red means error only.
Don't add a colored border-left/border-right accent bar to a card, row, callout, or alert — this pattern is banned, not merely discouraged.
Don't use a dashed perforated-tape pair of borders on a row — use a single solid ink-tinted rule.
Don't draw a straight routing vector or a curved cable with a terminal-jack circle for dependency edges — use a smooth isobar-style contour curve.
Don't reintroduce gradient text, glass/blur as decoration, or a second saturated primary accent alongside teal.
Don't use the teal-glow shadow on anything that isn't the primary action or a genuinely active/selected element.
Don't stack a separate workspace-identity header row above the tab row.
Don't style form controls, buttons, or badges with ad hoc hex colors — every color should trace back to a CSS custom property in src/index.css.
